name: 20850 · Rockville, MD
findings: ZIP 20850 (Rockville) has 450 nonprofit organizations. 200 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 173 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20850 (Rockville) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20850 (Rockville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.0 times the typical level).
